name: Lystra
line: Lystra was a city in Lycaonia where Paul healed a lame man, and where Timothy, who later joined Paul's work, was known as a disciple.

moments.title: Fleeing to Lystra
moments.text: Paul and Barnabas learned of a plan to mistreat and stone them, so they fled to Lystra and Derbe. There they kept preaching the gospel.

moments.title: A lame man walks
moments.text: A man in Lystra had been lame from birth. Paul saw that he had faith to be healed and told him to stand, and the man jumped up and walked.

moments.title: Mistaken for gods
moments.text: The crowds called Barnabas Zeus and Paul Hermes. The priest of Zeus brought bulls and wreaths to offer a sacrifice, but Barnabas and Paul tore their clothes and rushed into the crowd.

moments.title: Returning to strengthen disciples
moments.text: After preaching in Derbe, Paul and Barnabas came back to Lystra. They strengthened the disciples, encouraged them to continue in the faith, and appointed elders in each church.

moments.title: Timothy joins Paul
moments.text: In Lystra Paul found a disciple named Timothy, whom the brothers there spoke well of. Paul wanted Timothy to go with him.
